notes.title: v2.0.0 - The Multi-Peter Update

I am fairly confident v2.0.0 is stable, but I will continue to monitor the megathread on the Steam community board and release hotfixes when necessary.[/p][p][/p][p]And now...[/p][h1]\[ ----- v2.0.0 1-4 players[/p][/*][*][p]All game modes are temporarily unlocked while playing online[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added "Map view" mode (press F9 to notes.title: Online Multiplayer Public Beta!
notes.content:
Peter Shorts' big birthday update is almost ready! You can opt-into the [b]public_beta[/b] branch to try it out!

Enter the door titled [b]PLAY ONLINE[/b] (to the left of the title) to create/join a lobby.

All game modes are supported, including VS mode, Story mode, and all the side-games. All modes and characters will be temporarily unlocked when playing online.

Please send any bug reports to the megathread on the Steam Community forum, or in the comments on this post.

Full patch notes will be available once the update is pushed to the main branch.

notes.title: v1.0.18 Patch notes roundup
notes.content:
More patch notes for the last few versions. Mostly bug fixes with a few small features thrown in. Here are the major additions:
[list]
[*] VS mode has a random character button now.
[*] Performance mode was added. It basically just shrinks the area things are activated closer to the bounds of the view. Enable this if your game has trouble running at 60fps consistently in the main game.
[*] Lots of level design tweaks to make the game a little easier to explore.
[/list]
[h3]FULL PATCH NOTES[/h3]

generally made the wind area easier to navigate
added more easy mode platforms
added a lot more hard mode bananas
fixed a bug where you could start a VS match with only one peter

made combo counter read as "-0 combo" when you recover from being comboed
^ (previously this read as "0x COMBO" in red text
fixed tomato vines being invisible during escape sequence

notes.title: macOS port delayed indefinitely
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I've got bad news for mac users - the game (in its current state) will not run on macOS.

Does this mean the macOS port is canceled? Well, for the foreseeable future, yeah :(

The main technical issue is that the YYC compiler is now required for Steam API. Peter Shorts is built for VM export right now and converting it to YYC would take a huge amount of time and debugging. I even attempted a macOS VM export with Steam disabled, but it crashes immediately without an error message, so I'm not even sure what the next steps are.

I'll try the macOS export again when I have the time & resources to do so. I may have to convert the code to YYC anyway for (possible) console ports, so I'll probably try it again by the time that happens.

Sorry for listing "macOS" in the trailer without having fully tested it, but I was pretty confident it'd [i]at least[/i] run. Even Tres-Bashers compiled on macOS with VM with no issues, but that was before the Steam API was separated into an add-on by GameMaker. Another frustrating consequence of this is that I can no longer update the macOS version of my previous game - Tres-Bashers - leaving Mac users stranded on an old version.

I've made an attempt to support macOS for every game I've released (and without the help of a publisher) so it's pretty disappointing I hit this roadblock. I don't like Apple personally, but I had a MacBook for many years in school, so I know what it's like to be stuck with one as your primary gaming device.

Anyway, I'm sorry for getting any Mac users hopes up. I will attempt a Mac port again in the future, but for now I'm gonna have to cut my losses and focus on updates for the WIndows version.

notes.title: v1.0.15 Steam AutoCloud support on Windows
notes.content:
Hi everyone. This round of hotfixes addresses issues with save data backups, as well as some level design tweaks.

Steam AutoCloud has been enabled for Windows. It is untested on Steam Deck at the moment, but should work assuming Proton Compatibility mode just simulates the Windows file path. I don't own a Steam Deck so if anyone can confirm that, that'd be cool.

[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]

v1.0.11
Save files can be transferred between devices now
made some of the swings wider
icicle hp 3 -> 4
escape sequence missile part is easier now
escape sequence fan section has elec plugs now
added more easy mode platforms
hard mode has banana peels now
various level adjustments

v1.0.12 - v1.0.14 (Beta branch only)
Hotfixed & tested a lot of save backup issues (Thanks to SeymourSchlong)

v1.0.15
lowercased the "a" in "are" in all references to the title, including the executable
fixed a bug where the ending result time could be 10-30 seconds longer, despite save file time
Re-recorded the tutorial again

notes.title: v1.0.10 - Hotfix roundup, macOS port coming soon
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I hope you're all enjoying the game! Launch weekend was pretty crazy, but I appreciate everyone who submitted bug reports. We're on version 1.0.10 now, so I figured it's time to post the patch notes so far.

macOS version [i]should[/i] be up tomorrow. Kinda glad I waited on it considering the flaws in older versions. I don't own a new enough macbook to export the game myself, so the macOS version will likely get future patches a little late until I have a consistent way to export.
